authority: Independent CTO / Co-founder Directive W014 Mandal Version Final Integrity Correction

existing_columns: state_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES states(code)

w014_anchor_pattern_analysis.finding: In Migration 041 (lines 369-395), current_version_id was added to states, districts, pcs, and constituencies as a plain nullable foreign key (REFERENCES <version_table>(id) ON DELETE SET NULL). However, plain foreign keys cannot declaratively enforce that current_version_id belongs to the same anchor entity or that is_current is true.
w014_anchor_pattern_analysis.anchor_temporal_truth_evaluation: Migration 041 added valid_from, valid_to, and is_current to anchor tables in addition to version tables. For mandals, duplicating valid_from and valid_to on the anchor introduces conflicting sources of truth. The refined architecture isolates temporal validity intervals (valid_from, valid_to) strictly to public.mandal_versions, while public.mandals holds only current_version_id and entity-level is_active.

bidirectional_current_version_integrity.problem_statement: If mandals.current_version_id is protected only on INSERT/UPDATE of mandals, a direct UPDATE public.mandal_versions SET is_current = false WHERE id = <referenced_id> causes silent divergence, leaving mandals.current_version_id pointing to an inactive version.
bidirectional_current_version_integrity.architectural_solution: 4-Layer Bidirectional Integrity Framework combining composite foreign keys, PostgreSQL deferred constraint triggers on both tables, and partial unique indexing.

layer_1_composite_fk.mandals_fk: FOREIGN KEY (current_version_id, id) REFERENCES public.mandal_versions(id, mandal_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
layer_1_composite_fk.guarantee: Declaratively guarantees same-anchor identity. mandals.current_version_id cannot resolve to a version belonging to any other mandal_id. Cross-mandal assignment fails with 23503. Deletion of referenced version is RESTRICTed.

layer_2_anchor_constraint_trigger.type: CONSTRAINT TRIGGER ... AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF current_version_id DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
layer_2_anchor_constraint_trigger.guarantee: Asserts at commit time that mandals.current_version_id resolves to a mandal_versions row with is_current = true. Fails closed with ERR-W014-001 (23514) on any attempt to point to an inactive version.

layer_3_version_constraint_trigger.type: CONSTRAINT TRIGGER ... AFTER UPDATE OF is_current OR DELETE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
layer_3_version_constraint_trigger.guarantee: Asserts at commit time that if a mandal_version transitions from is_current = true to false or is deleted, NO row in public.mandals has current_version_id pointing to it. Direct deactivation while referenced fails closed with ERR-W014-002 (23514).

layer_4_single_current_partial_index.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mandal_versions_single_current ON public.mandal_versions (mandal_id) WHERE is_current = true;
layer_4_single_current_partial_index.guarantee: Strictly guarantees that at most one version per mandal_id can have is_current = true simultaneously. Setting a second version to is_current = true violates 23505.

bidirectional_current_version_integrity.divergence_proof: Divergence requires mandals.current_version_id = V AND mandal_versions(V).is_current = false. Case 1: Mandals modified to point to inactive V -> Layer 2 detects V.is_current = false at commit and aborts. Case 2: mandal_versions(V) modified from true to false while mandals points to V -> Layer 3 detects mandals.current_version_id = V at commit and aborts. Case 3: mandal_versions(V) deleted -> Layer 1 RESTRICT aborts, Layer 3 aborts. Case 4: V belongs to different mandal -> Layer 1 composite FK rejects at engine level. Divergence is mathematically and structurally impossible.

authoritative_state_transition_path.transition_function: public.fn_transition_mandal_current_version(p_mandal_id TEXT, p_new_version_id UUID, p_effective_date DATE, p_operator TEXT, p_provenance_id UUID DEFAULT NULL)
authoritative_state_transition_path.execution_model: Single atomic PostgreSQL transaction with row-level anchor locking (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE)
step_sequence: 1. Acquire row-level lock on public.mandals WHERE id = p_mandal_id FOR UPDATE (serializes transitions).
2. Validate p_new_version_id exists in mandal_versions and fetch mandal_id, valid_to, and primary_dataset_version_id.
3. Verify same-anchor ownership: assert new_version.mandal_id == p_mandal_id; abort with 23514 if mismatched.
4. Verify eligibility: assert new_version.valid_to IS NULL; abort with 23514 if version is historically closed.
5. If p_new_version_id is already current, return idempotent NO_OP receipt.
6. Retire previous version: UPDATE mandal_versions SET is_current = false, valid_to = p_effective_date WHERE id = old_version_id.
7. Activate successor version: UPDATE mandal_versions SET is_current = true, valid_from = COALESCE(p_effective_date, valid_from), valid_to = NULL WHERE id = p_new_version_id.
8. Update anchor pointer: UPDATE mandals SET current_version_id = p_new_version_id, updated_at = now() WHERE id = p_mandal_id.
9. Commit transaction: Deferred constraint triggers Layer 2 and Layer 3 validate mutual integrity and succeed.
authoritative_state_transition_path.failure_behavior: Any failure at any step immediately aborts transaction with ROLLBACK. No partial state can persist. Default is_current is fail-closed (false).

semantic_distinction.is_current_meaning: Temporal bookkeeping within dataset lineage. Indicates that this version is the latest known open-ended state (valid_to IS NULL) for this mandal entity in this dataset.
semantic_distinction.legal_authority_meaning: Conferred EXCLUSIVELY by W012 dataset governance status (dataset_versions.default_status = 'OFFICIAL') backed by verified cryptographic evidence in evidence_records and record_provenance_linkages.

four_way_relationship.primary_dataset_version_id: Foreign key to W012 dataset_versions envelope.
four_way_relationship.evidence_records_linkage: Cryptographic hash and Gazette statutory citation validating official enactment.

unverified_candidate_rules.scoping: A candidate or research dataset (e.g., TGRAC 589 candidate snapshot) may have is_current = true strictly for internal temporal continuity within its own dataset lineage.
prevention_of_legal_truth_leakage: Public views and legal reporting MUST use compound filter: WHERE mv.is_current = true AND dv.default_status = 'OFFICIAL' AND dv.superseded_by IS NULL.
Production mandals.current_version_id is restricted to dataset_versions with default_status = 'OFFICIAL'.
Promotion of any candidate version to OFFICIAL requires formal W012 evidence verification and CTO sign-off.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: mandals.current_version_id -> mandal_versions(id, mandal_id) composite FK enforced
acceptance_matrix.mechanism: FOREIGN KEY (current_version_id, id) REFERENCES public.mandal_versions(id, mandal_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
acceptance_matrix.verification: Attempting to set mandals.current_version_id to a version belonging to a different mandal_id fails with Foreign Key Violation (23503).

acceptance_matrix.mechanism: Constraint trigger trg_guard_mandal_current_version ON public.mandals (DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)
acceptance_matrix.verification: Direct UPDATE public.mandals SET current_version_id = <inactive_version_id> raises ERR-W014-001 (23514) at commit.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: mandal_versions.is_current cannot be set false while referenced by mandals.current_version_id
acceptance_matrix.mechanism: Constraint trigger trg_guard_mandal_version_retirement ON public.mandal_versions (DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)
acceptance_matrix.verification: Direct UPDATE public.mandal_versions SET is_current = false WHERE id = <referenced_id> raises ERR-W014-002 (23514) at commit.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: At most one is_current=true per mandal_id
acceptance_matrix.mechanism: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mandal_versions_single_current ON public.mandal_versions (mandal_id) WHERE is_current = true
acceptance_matrix.verification: Attempting to set is_current = true on a second version of the same mandal fails with Unique Violation (23505).

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Direct invalid mutations fail-closed with explicit error
acceptance_matrix.mechanism: Triggers raise explicit ERR-W014-001 and ERR-W014-002 exceptions with standard SQLSTATE 23514.
acceptance_matrix.verification: Ad-hoc SQL mutations leaving divergent state roll back immediately with explicit diagnostic errors.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Version transition via authorized path succeeds atomically
acceptance_matrix.mechanism: Stored function public.fn_transition_mandal_current_version() wraps lock, old version deactivation, new version activation, and anchor pointer update in a single atomic transaction.
acceptance_matrix.verification: Calling fn_transition_mandal_current_version() with valid parameters transitions state atomically; returns structured JSONB receipt.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: UNVERIFIED candidate versions cannot be promoted to current legal truth without W012 evidence
acceptance_matrix.mechanism: Views and legal reporting require compound check (mv.is_current = true AND dv.default_status = 'OFFICIAL'); initial migration prohibits seeding unevidenced mandals as OFFICIAL.
acceptance_matrix.verification: Candidate versions with dv.default_status = 'UNVERIFIED' are filtered out from canonical legal views; 9 unevidenced mandals have zero OFFICIAL versions seeded.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: mandal_versions has a real FK to mandals

acceptance_matrix.verification: INSERT mandal_version with non-existent mandal_id fails with foreign key violation 23503.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Every mandal_version resolves to exactly one stable mandal identity
acceptance_matrix.mechanism: NOT NULL foreign key constraint on mandal_id ensures 100% resolution to public.mandals
acceptance_matrix.verification: Querying mandal_versions with LEFT JOIN mandals WHERE mandals.id IS NULL returns 0 rows.
